quests.title: No Names Left to Call
quests.text: Mud has taken the names from their coats, but the Mire-Cured Husks still report for duty. Lay five to rest by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}. Accord or Throng, a body deserves better than another shift in that mud.

quests.title: A Fare for Nobody
quests.text: The Fordwater Zombies still hold out their hands for a fare, though I doubt any remember the crossing. Destroy five after dark at the {name:front_broken_causeway/last_ford}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/last_ford}. Keep your coins; I have tried paying, and the service is dreadful.

quests.title: Group: Close the Account
quests.text: War Construct Last-Toll waits in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct}; whoever built it neglected to include a closing hour. Take a group and destroy it, because it will make spare parts of a lone fighter. We have quite enough spare parts here already.

quests.title: The Dead Are Not Rations
quests.text: I set the dead in order, and the Saltpack Blightfang Wolves scatter them again before the graves are ready. Kill five by day in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}. There is only so much dignity I can retrieve from a muzzle.

quests.title: The Owners Still Object
quests.text: Saltroad Deserters are stripping the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_galleries}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_galleries}, day and night. They call the tombs abandoned. Kill five of the robbers; some of us take a very long time to answer the door.

quests.title: Someone Who Listens
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener hears the Last Watch in the wind, and lately she has heard little worth smiling about. Go speak with her at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise and say Orrel Hollowstep trusts your work. I should warn you: she hears muttering just as clearly.

quests.title: Bounty: Premature Shrouds
quests.text: Salt-Web Bonelurker Spiders in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, begin their shrouding work after dark. They rarely wait for the occupant to stop objecting. Kill five there at night and return for payment; this bounty opens again twenty-five minutes after turn-in.

quests.title: What the Salt Holds
quests.text: The salt has kept their bodies, but when I listen for their voices there is only the scrape of feet. Lay five Saltbound Sun-Dried Husks to rest by day in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}. Preserving someone ought to mean more than keeping them upright.

quests.title: Let Me Have the Last Word
quests.text: The Salt-Hex Bog Witches whisper hexes over the dead, and the dead cannot rest while they listen. Kill four after dark in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, and bring me two Last-Hex Shards. I will read every hex carved into them, and then the dead can stop listening.

quests.title: Relief Long Overdue
quests.text: Nobody came to relieve the Last-Watch Mummies, so they gave their posts everything, even the years after death. Lay five to rest by day on the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}. Let them go with more respect than their commanders ever showed them.

quests.title: Dismissed, Captain
quests.text: Watch-Captain Huskell calls soldiers of both armies from the Undertithe's roll; each fresh payment buys their names for another watch. Kill four Last-Watch Skeleton Raiders at night in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood} and defeat Huskell, {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}. I have listened long enough to hear the same names twice; let me hear where his list ends.

quests.title: Group: Nobody's Number
quests.text: Bog Witch Salt-Counter holds court {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, counting soldiers as though they were grains of salt. Gather a group and kill her; her power is more than one fighter can bear. I remember names, and I would prefer not to add yours to the list I mourn.

quests.title: Bounty: A Patient Listener
quests.text: Some of the dead need someone to hear them before they can be still. Destroy five Last-Watch Skeleton Raiders at night in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood}, and bring me two Unquiet Bones. You may take this bounty again half an hour after turn-in; I can always make time to listen.

quests.title: The Fire Is New
quests.text: This Tithe-Brand is fresh furnace work; Mortuary Clerk Hush once entered our dead as debtors without needing a fire. Accept its coin as pay and it owns you, living or dead; a living holder cannot throw it away or cool it except by paying for another death. Wash the fresh ash from the old stone at the {name:ashen_grave}, {dir_from_giver:ashen_grave}, to see the brand laid over the names. Report to the Warmaster; being Undead has never made us somebody's property.

objectives.label: Wash fresh ash from old stone

quests.title: No Names Left to Own
quests.text: Huskell's roll ends with Mardra in fresh ink, and Chirr's payroll claims the same dead for the Undertithe. Burn our dead off the tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_077}; leave it no names to own. With the names gone from root and stone, the debt has nothing to hold, and its collector will come to the stone in person. Tell the Warmaster what we have called up.

objectives.label: Burn our dead off the tally

quests.title: The Answering Blow
quests.text: His body is broken, but the crack still burns and I can hear movement below it. Carry my account to the Warmaster at Bannerbreak Warhold, where the drill yard can hear it too. His last blow struck the ground. The answering blow came from underneath.
